issue.title: depends build fails due to OpenBSD touch incompatibility with -h option
issue.body:
While trying to cross-compile / build Bitcoin Core on an OpenBSD host or using the OpenBSD dependency builder (`depends/builders/openbsd.mk`), the build process encounters an incompatibility with the `touch` utility.

Specifically, OpenBSD's native `touch` command does not recognize or support the `-h` flag (which is typically used to change the timestamps of symbolic links rather than the files they point to on other Unix variants like GNU coreutils/Linux).

The `openbsd.mk` file currently defines specific command overrides for OpenBSD tools (e.g., setting `build_openbsd_TOUCH = touch -m -t 200001011200`). However, anywhere the `-h` flag is being passed to `touch` during the OpenBSD build workflow, it needs to be adjusted or stripped since OpenBSD's `touch` doesn't support modifying symlink timestamps via `-h`.
